dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「すっかり暗くなっちゃったねえ……」
dialogues.en: "It's gotten dark so quickly..."
dialogues.text: "It's gotten dark so quickly..."

dialogues.jp:
ほうとため息をついて、ことりが空を見上げる。
星が輝くほど真っ暗ではないものの、もはや、
陽光はかけらも見当たらない。
dialogues.en:
She let out a small sigh, and looked up at the night sky,
twinkling brightly with stars. It almost seemed like it was
daytime.
dialogues.text:
She let out a small sigh, and looked up at the night sky,
twinkling brightly with stars. It almost seemed like it was
daytime.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「早く、夏にならないかなあ……」
dialogues.en: "Summer should hurry up and come already..."
dialogues.text: "Summer should hurry up and come already..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「夏、好きなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "You like the summer season?"
dialogues.text: "You like the summer season?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ううん、そうでもないよ。汗かくのとか、あ
　んまり好きじゃないし」
dialogues.en:
"Umm, not really. It's a time of sweatiness and stickiness,
I don't like that."
dialogues.text:
"Umm, not really. It's a time of sweatiness and stickiness,
I don't like that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "......? Then why do you want it to hurry up and come?"
dialogues.text: "......? Then why do you want it to hurry up and come?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だって、夏は、夜まで長いでしょ。だから、
　その分、一緒に居られるなって……」
dialogues.en:
"Because the summer nights come later. Then I can spend more
time outside together..."
dialogues.text:
"Because the summer nights come later. Then I can spend more
time outside together..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「俺と？」
dialogues.en: "With me?"
dialogues.text: "With me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「他に居ないよぅ……」
dialogues.en: "There isn't anyone else around~..."
dialogues.text: "There isn't anyone else around~..."

dialogues.jp:
どこか甘えを含んだ響きで、指を、深く絡めて
くる。
dialogues.en: Her sweet smile showed again, our fingers intertwined.
dialogues.text: Her sweet smile showed again, our fingers intertwined.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、そんな、日が落ちたからって、必ずし
　も家に帰る必要もないんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, even so, just because the sun sets, doesn't mean we
have to go home, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, even so, just because the sun sets, doesn't mean we
have to go home, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、え？　そ、それってどういう意味かな？」
dialogues.en: "E, eh? W, what do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "E, eh? W, what do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「どういう意味って……あれだよ。たとえば星
　座を見に行く時とか。日が落ちてからが本番
　だろ？」
dialogues.en:
"I mean stuff... like that. To go stargazing. That's not
something you can do until the set sets."
dialogues.text:
"I mean stuff... like that. To go stargazing. That's not
something you can do until the set sets."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ……うん。そうだね。そうだよね。うん
　うん、それは夜が本番ですな」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh...I see. Yes, yes, of course, nighttime is the best
time for that."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh...I see. Yes, yes, of course, nighttime is the best
time for that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり、何か期待外れって感じがしてる」
dialogues.en: "Kotori, you were thinking of something else, weren't you."
dialogues.text: "Kotori, you were thinking of something else, weren't you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そ、そんなことないよぅ。私、朝倉君と一緒
　に、星座見たいよ？」
dialogues.en:
"N, not at all! I just want to see the stars together with
you!"
dialogues.text:
"N, not at all! I just want to see the stars together with
you!"

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅっと力を込めて握ってきた手から、ことり
の気持ちが伝わってくるようだった。
dialogues.en:
I felt Kotori grip my hand even tighter, passing her
feelings to me through that link.
dialogues.text:
I felt Kotori grip my hand even tighter, passing her
feelings to me through that link.

dialogues.jp: 「俺もだ」
dialogues.en: "I do too."
dialogues.text: "I do too."

dialogues.jp: 俺もギュッと手を握り返す。
dialogues.en: I returned her tight grip.
dialogues.text: I returned her tight grip.

dialogues.jp:
つないだところから、胸の高鳴りが、鼓動の速
さが、ドキドキが広がっていく感じがした。
dialogues.en:
I could feel my heart pounding quickly, and I thought I
could feel hers too.
dialogues.text:
I could feel my heart pounding quickly, and I thought I
could feel hers too.

dialogues.jp:
「他にも夜に楽しむものはいっぱいあるぜ。花
　火とか、肝試しとか、学園の怪談とか」
dialogues.en:
"And nighttime is usually a time for fun. Fireworks, dares,
school ghost stories..."
dialogues.text:
"And nighttime is usually a time for fun. Fireworks, dares,
school ghost stories..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「微妙に違うのが混ざってるような……」
dialogues.en: "One of them is a bit out of place..."
dialogues.text: "One of them is a bit out of place..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……でも、うん。一緒に、色んなこと、した
　いね」
dialogues.en: "...But yeah, some things are enjoyable at night..."
dialogues.text: "...But yeah, some things are enjoyable at night..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふたりなら、きっと楽しいんだろうね……」
dialogues.en:
"But things are always better when you're experiencing them
with a loved one..."
dialogues.text:
"But things are always better when you're experiencing them
with a loved one..."

dialogues.jp:
そんなこんなで、空に星がくっきりと浮かび上
がる頃、ことりの家に着いた。
dialogues.en:
As we talked mindlessly about this and that, we soon reached
Kotori's house.
dialogues.text:
As we talked mindlessly about this and that, we soon reached
Kotori's house.

dialogues.jp: 門の前で、ことりがくるりと振り返る。
dialogues.en:
In front of the entrance to her house, Kotori turned around
to face me.
dialogues.text:
In front of the entrance to her house, Kotori turned around
to face me.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう。今日は、楽しかったよ」
dialogues.en: "Thanks for today. It was lots of fun."
dialogues.text: "Thanks for today. It was lots of fun."

dialogues.jp:
名残惜しい時間。少しでも引き延ばしたいと思っ
ているのは、たぶん、ふたりとも同じだった。
dialogues.en:
She was reluctant to just leave. Just like me, we were
trying to find any way to delay it.
dialogues.text:
She was reluctant to just leave. Just like me, we were
trying to find any way to delay it.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうだ、ことり、携帯電話の番号教えて
　くれない？　まだ、聞いてなかったから」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, by the by, can you tell me your cellphone number? I've
not heard it before."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, by the by, can you tell me your cellphone number? I've
not heard it before."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、えと、その……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, um, about that..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um, about that..."

dialogues.jp:
一瞬虚を衝かれたような顔をして、ことりはゆっ
くりとかぶりを振った。
dialogues.en:
It appears I'd just hit a weak spot somehow... the fairly
simple question got her incredibly flustered.
dialogues.text:
It appears I'd just hit a weak spot somehow... the fairly
simple question got her incredibly flustered.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ごめん、その……私、電話って苦手で、
　だから、携帯電話とか持ってなくて……」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, sorry... I'm not good at phone conversations, so I
never bothered getting a cellphone..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, sorry... I'm not good at phone conversations, so I
never bothered getting a cellphone..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうだったんだ。だったら、別にいいん
　だけどさ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I see. Nothing wrong with that."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I see. Nothing wrong with that."

dialogues.jp:
ばつの悪い思いをさせてしまったと思い、俺は
慌てて手を振った。
dialogues.en:
Seeing that she was actually feeling bad about that, I
hastily waved away my question.
dialogues.text:
Seeing that she was actually feeling bad about that, I
hastily waved away my question.

dialogues.jp:
（そう言えば、前に電話で話した時、妙におど
　おどしてたけど、苦手だったからか）
dialogues.en:
"(Come to think about it, the last time we talked on the
phone, she really was nervous. She really must be weak at
it.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Come to think about it, the last time we talked on the
phone, she really was nervous. She really must be weak at
it.)"

dialogues.jp:
「なら、俺からもあんまり電話とか掛けないよ
　うにした方がいいのかな？」
dialogues.en: "Then I should try not to call your home phone as well?"
dialogues.text: "Then I should try not to call your home phone as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん……ごめんね。そうしてくれる」
dialogues.en: "Yes... I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Yes... I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「謝ることじゃない。分かったよ」
dialogues.en: "No need to apologize, I undestand."
dialogues.text: "No need to apologize, I undestand."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ね、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Then, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Then, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「その分、別れる前に、いつも次に会う時の約
　束をしよう？」
dialogues.en:
"To counter that, let's promise that everytime, before we
say goodbye, we set a time and date for when to meet next."
dialogues.text:
"To counter that, let's promise that everytime, before we
say goodbye, we set a time and date for when to meet next."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、それがいいな」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, that'd be nice."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, that'd be nice."

dialogues.jp:
日時の確認を二度してから、俺はあらためて別
れの挨拶を告げた。
dialogues.en:
We scheduled the next time we'd meet, and had to say our
farewells again.
dialogues.text:
We scheduled the next time we'd meet, and had to say our
farewells again.

dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ……そろそろ」
dialogues.en: "I guess I should be going... now."
dialogues.text: "I guess I should be going... now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん、また」
dialogues.en: "Uhn... I'd see you later..."
dialogues.text: "Uhn... I'd see you later..."

dialogues.jp: 小さく手を振り合う。
dialogues.en: I gave her a short wave of my hand.
dialogues.text: I gave her a short wave of my hand.

dialogues.jp: ことりを向いたまま、１歩、後ろに下がる。
dialogues.en: But rather than going back, she took a step towards me.
dialogues.text: But rather than going back, she took a step towards me.

dialogues.en: One step.
dialogues.text: One step.

dialogues.jp: また、１歩。
dialogues.en: Another step.
dialogues.text: Another step.

dialogues.jp: 少しずつ、ことりとの距離が離れていく。
dialogues.en:
Bit by bit, the distance between us had become almost
non-existant.
dialogues.text:
Bit by bit, the distance between us had become almost
non-existant.

dialogues.jp: と、ことりが一息に間合いを詰めて。
dialogues.en: Then our bodies met.
dialogues.text: Then our bodies met.

dialogues.jp: 俺の胸と唇に、そっと身体の一部を重ねた。
dialogues.en: I could feel her body on my chest and lips.
dialogues.text: I could feel her body on my chest and lips.

dialogues.jp: 柔らかな手の平と、少しだけ冷えた唇と……。
dialogues.en: Her soft palms, and her slightly chilly lips...
dialogues.text: Her soft palms, and her slightly chilly lips...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「えへへ……」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe..."
dialogues.text: "Ehehe..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「約束だけじゃ、あまりにも寂しすぎるもんね」
dialogues.en:
"Even though we promised, it's still going to be a little
lonely."
dialogues.text:
"Even though we promised, it's still going to be a little
lonely."

dialogues.jp: そう言うことりを、俺は抱きしめたくなって。
dialogues.en: As she talked, she started hugging me.
dialogues.text: As she talked, she started hugging me.

dialogues.jp: 思わず手が伸びたその時。
dialogues.en: Just as I was about to wrap my hands around her as well...
dialogues.text: Just as I was about to wrap my hands around her as well...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「う〜、おっほん」
dialogues.en: "Aaaaahem!"
dialogues.text: "Aaaaahem!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Ahhh!?"
dialogues.text: "Ahhh!?"

dialogues.jp: 振り返る前から声の主は分かっていた。
dialogues.en: I turned my head around and saw the owner of the voice.
dialogues.text: I turned my head around and saw the owner of the voice.

dialogues.jp: 「こ、暦先生……」
dialogues.en: "Ko, Koyomi-sensei..."
dialogues.text: "Ko, Koyomi-sensei..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いやいや、結構結構。お別れのチッスですか
　い？　若いってのは、特権だねえ」
dialogues.en:
"Ah-ah, absolutely wonderful. A romantic parting scene, no?
The hallmark of the young."
dialogues.text:
"Ah-ah, absolutely wonderful. A romantic parting scene, no?
The hallmark of the young."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、壇上でやらかすぐらいのふたりだ。家の
　前でなんて、お茶の子さいさいってところ？」
dialogues.en:
"You two really were meant for the stage. Why not come in
for tea instead of standing out here."
dialogues.text:
"You two really were meant for the stage. Why not come in
for tea instead of standing out here."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっと、そ、それじゃ、朝倉君、バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "Uh, s, so, I'd see you later, Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Uh, s, so, I'd see you later, Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.jp:
唯一のお味方は、そうそうに戦線を離脱してし
まった。
dialogues.en:
My lone ally withdrew from the battlefield almost
immediately.
dialogues.text:
My lone ally withdrew from the battlefield almost
immediately.

dialogues.jp: ひゅるる……。
dialogues.en: --*Whoosh*
dialogues.text: --*Whoosh*

dialogues.jp:
夜風が、暦先生の髪の毛とタバコの煙を流して
いく。
dialogues.en:
The night wind was blowing Koyomi-sensei's hair and
cigarette smoke in a hypnotic fashion.
dialogues.text:
The night wind was blowing Koyomi-sensei's hair and
cigarette smoke in a hypnotic fashion.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、え〜と、それじゃ、俺もこれで……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, uhm, I'd, take my leave now..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, uhm, I'd, take my leave now..."

dialogues.jp:
さくさくと、カニのように横に歩き、危険区域
からの脱走を試みる。
dialogues.en:
I started inching sideways like a crab, trying to escape
from the danger zone without angering the predator further.
dialogues.text:
I started inching sideways like a crab, trying to escape
from the danger zone without angering the predator further.

dialogues.jp: ――ガシッ
dialogues.en: --*grab*
dialogues.text: --*grab*

dialogues.jp: 首に回された腕に、あえなく阻止された。
dialogues.en: She grabbed the back of my shirt, preventing me from escape.
dialogues.text: She grabbed the back of my shirt, preventing me from escape.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ、さ、く、ら、く〜ん」
dialogues.en: "A. Sa. Ku. Ra. Kun."
dialogues.text: "A. Sa. Ku. Ra. Kun."

dialogues.jp:
紫煙と共に、顔に言葉がぶつかってくる。物理
的な圧力を以って。
dialogues.en:
Like her cigarette smoke, every syllable she uttered struck
me like a ton of bricks. This is some freakish pressure...
dialogues.text:
Like her cigarette smoke, every syllable she uttered struck
me like a ton of bricks. This is some freakish pressure...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「遊びだったら、承知しないからね」
dialogues.en:
"I won't consent to anything less than 100% commitment.
Capisce?"
dialogues.text:
"I won't consent to anything less than 100% commitment.
Capisce?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「は、はは〜」
dialogues.en: "C, capisce!"
dialogues.text: "C, capisce!"

dialogues.jp: ◆暦先生に見られる◆
dialogues.en: ◆Caught by Koyomi-sensei◆
dialogues.text: ◆Caught by Koyomi-sensei◆

dialogues.jp:
夜になり、ことりを家へと送る。やっぱり、甘っ
たるい雰囲気。
dialogues.en:
As night came, we returned to Kotori's home. The night
atmosphere was fantastic.
dialogues.text:
As night came, we returned to Kotori's home. The night
atmosphere was fantastic.

dialogues.jp:
家の前で携帯の番号を尋ねたのだが、苦手だか
ら持ってないと言われた。
dialogues.en:
I asked for her cellphone number as we reached her house,
but she revealed that she's not good on the phone.
dialogues.text:
I asked for her cellphone number as we reached her house,
but she revealed that she's not good on the phone.

dialogues.jp:
別れの前にキスを交わして……それを、暦先生
に見られてしまった。……やば。
dialogues.en:
As we were about to have a farewell kiss... we were caught
in the act by Koyomi-sensei. ...Oh boy.
dialogues.text:
As we were about to have a farewell kiss... we were caught
in the act by Koyomi-sensei. ...Oh boy.
